# Loading in Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
C.train <- read_csv("SkinCancerTrain.csv")
C.test <- read_csv("SkinCancerTestNoY.csv")
```

# Imputing Missing Values

```{r}
# Get rid of the index column
C.train <- C.train[, -1]
C.test <- C.test[, -1]

# Convert character to factor
C.train <- C.train |> mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
C.test <- C.test |> mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Missing Values
num_cols <- C.train |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> colnames()
num_cols
cat_cols <- setdiff(names(C.train), c(num_cols, "Cancer"))
cat_cols

get_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]         # remove NAs first
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

for (col in num_cols) {
  med <- median(C.train[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  C.train[[col]][is.na(C.train[[col]])] <- med
  C.test[[col]][is.na(C.test[[col]])] <- med
}

for (col in cat_cols) {
  mode1 <- get_mode(C.train[[col]])
  C.train[[col]][is.na(C.train[[col]])] <- mode1
  C.test[[col]][is.na(C.test[[col]])] <- mode1
}


```


# Variable Selection

```{r}
# Chi square test using categorical variables
chi_results <- data.frame(
  variable = character(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  test_used = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (col in cat_cols) {

  tab <- table(C.train[[col]], C.train$Cancer)

    test <- chisq.test(tab)
    p <- test$p.value

  chi_results <- rbind(
    chi_results,
    data.frame(variable = col, p_value = p)
  )
}

# Sort by significance
chi_results <- chi_results |> arrange(p_value)
chi_results
```

```{r}
# ANOVA test using numerical variables
num_cols <- C.train |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  colnames()

anova_results <- data.frame(
  variable = character(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (col in num_cols) {
  f <- as.formula(paste(col, "~ Cancer"))
  test <- aov(f, data = C.train)
  p <- summary(test)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
  
  anova_results <- rbind(
    anova_results,
    data.frame(variable = col, p_value = p)
  )
}

anova_results <- anova_results |> arrange(p_value)
anova_results
```

```{r}
# Drop insignificant categorical and numerical variables
drop_cat <- chi_results |> 
  filter(p_value >= 0.08) |> 
  pull(variable)

C.train_reduced <- C.train |> select(-all_of(drop_cat))
C.test_reduced  <- C.test  |> select(-all_of(drop_cat))

drop_numeric <- anova_results |> 
  filter(p_value >= 0.05) |> 
  pull(variable)

C.train_reduced <- C.train_reduced |> select(-all_of(drop_numeric))
C.test_reduced  <- C.test_reduced  |> select(-all_of(drop_numeric))
```

```{r}
# Scale the numerical variables for (logistic regression, LDA, QDA)
num_cols_reduced <- C.train_reduced |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  colnames()

library(caret)
preproc <- preProcess(
  C.train_reduced[, num_cols_reduced],
  method = c("center", "scale")
)

C.train_scaled <- C.train_reduced
C.test_scaled  <- C.test_reduced

C.train_scaled[, num_cols_reduced] <- predict(preproc, C.train_reduced[, num_cols_reduced])
C.test_scaled[,  num_cols_reduced] <- predict(preproc, C.test_reduced[, num_cols_reduced])
```

```{r}
# Hot-encoding categorical variables

# Remove the target from training before encoding
target <- C.train_scaled$Cancer
C.train_scaled$Cancer <- NULL

# Create dummy encoder from training set only
dummies <- dummyVars(" ~ .", data = C.train_scaled)

# Apply to both train and test
train_final <- predict(dummies, newdata = C.train_scaled) |> as.data.frame()
test_final  <- predict(dummies, newdata = C.test_scaled)  |> as.data.frame()

# Add target back to training data
train_final$Cancer <- target
C.train_scaled$Cancer <- target
```

# Models

## Logistic Regression with CV (0.60350)

```{r}
cv_ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
logit_cv <- train(Cancer ~ ., data = train_final, method = "multinom",
trControl = cv_ctrl, trace = FALSE)

logit_preds <- predict(logit_cv, newdata = test_final)

logit_cv$results  # shows cross-validated accuracy
confusionMatrix(predict(logit_cv, newdata = train_final), train_final$Cancer)

submission_logit <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(C.test_scaled), Cancer = logit_preds
)

write_csv(submission_logit, "submission_logit4.csv")
```

## KNN

```{r}
knn_train_final <- train_final
knn_train_final$uv_x_spf <- NULL
knn_train_final$hat_outdoor <- NULL
knn_train_final$photo_x_burn <- NULL

knn_test_final <- test_final
knn_test_final$uv_x_spf <- NULL
knn_test_final$hat_outdoor <- NULL
knn_test_final$photo_x_burn <- NULL

cv_ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10, classProbs = TRUE)

set.seed(1)
knn_model <- train(Cancer ~ ., data = knn_train_final, method = "knn", 
                   tuneGrid = expand.grid(k = seq(3, 21, 2)), 
                   trControl = cv_ctrl)

knn_model_high_k <- train(Cancer ~ ., data = knn_train_final, method = "knn", 
                          tuneGrid = expand.grid(k = seq(15, 51, 2)), 
                          trControl = cv_ctrl)


plot(knn_model_high_k)
knn_model_high_k$bestTune  # Best value of k

knn_preds <- predict(knn_model_high_k, newdata = knn_test_final)
submission_knn <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(knn_test_final),
  Cancer = knn_preds
)
write_csv(submission_knn, "submission_knn.csv")
```

## LASSO

```{r}
# UV x SPF
train_final$uv_x_spf <- train_final$avg_daily_uv * train_final$sunscreen_spf
test_final$uv_x_spf <- test_final$avg_daily_uv * test_final$sunscreen_spf

# Hat use often x outdoor job
if ("hat_use.Often" %in% names(train_final)) {
  train_final$hat_outdoor <- train_final$outdoor_job * train_final$`hat_use.Often`
  test_final$hat_outdoor <- test_final$outdoor_job * test_final$`hat_use.Often`
}

# Skin photosensitivity x high exposure
if ("skin_photosensitivity.High" %in% names(train_final)) {
  train_final$photo_x_burn <- train_final$`skin_photosensitivity.High` * train_final$sunburns_last_year
  test_final$photo_x_burn <- test_final$`skin_photosensitivity.High` * test_final$sunburns_last_year
}

# Age 

x <- as.matrix(train_final |> select(-Cancer))  # predictors
y <- ifelse(train_final$Cancer == "Malignant", 1, 0)  # binary target
x_test <- as.matrix(test_final)

set.seed(1)

cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = x,
  y = y,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,            # 1 = LASSO; try 0.5 for Elastic Net later
  type.measure = "auc", # Better than default "class" for imbalanced problems
  nfolds = 5
)

plot(cvfit)  # visualize lambda vs AUC

# Best lambda based on max AUC
best_lambda <- cvfit$lambda.min
best_lambda
coef(cvfit, s = best_lambda)
coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se")

# Predict probabilities
prob <- predict(cvfit, newx = x_test, s = best_lambda, type = "response")

# Class prediction
pred <- ifelse(prob > 0.5, "Malignant", "Benign")

# Create submission
submission <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(C.test_scaled),
  Cancer = as.vector(pred)
)

write_csv(submission2, "submission_lasso_1se.csv")
```

## Logit with Less Predictors

```{r}
selected_vars <- rownames(coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se"))[coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.1se")[,1] != 0]
selected_vars <- setdiff(selected_vars, "(Intercept)")
selected_vars_safe <- paste0("`", selected_vars, "`")  # backtick them
selected_vars

# Build formula string
formula_str <- paste("Cancer ~", paste(selected_vars_safe, collapse = " + "))
formula_obj <- as.formula(formula_str)

# Fit unpenalized logistic regression
```

## Random Forest

```{r}
library(randomForest)

set.seed(123)

x <- train_final |> select(-Cancer)
y <- train_final$Cancer

rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = x,
  y = y,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = sqrt(ncol(x)),
  importance = TRUE
)

rf_preds <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_final)

submission_rf <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(C.test_scaled),  # Or use original ID column if available
  Cancer = rf_preds
)


write_csv(submission_rf, "submission_random_forest.csv")
```

## Logistic Regression + BIC

```{r}
set.seed(1)

full_model <- glm(Cancer ~ ., data = train_final, family = "binomial")
bic_model <- step(full_model, direction = "backward", k = log(nrow(train_final)))
bic_formula <- formula(bic_model)
bic_formula
summary(bic_model)

set.seed(123)

cv_model <- train(
  bic_formula,
  data = train_final,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = cv_ctrl,
)

summary(cv_model)

bic_preds <- predict(cv_model, newdata = test_final)

submission_bic <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(lda_test),  # or original test IDs if available
  Cancer = bic_preds
)

write_csv(submission_bic, "submission_bic.csv")

```

## Logistic Regression + XGBoost

```{r}
bic_predictors <- c(
  "age", "skin_tone.Brown", "skin_tone.Dark", "skin_tone.Fair",
  "skin_tone.Medium", "skin_tone.Olive", "avg_daily_uv",
  "sunscreen_freq.Always", "sunscreen_freq.Often",
  "hat_use.Never", "clothing_protection.High", "clothing_protection.Low",
  "tanning_bed_use.Never", "tanning_bed_use.Often", "outdoor_job",
  "family_history.1st-degree", "family_history.2nd-degree",
  "immunosuppressed.No", "lesion_size_mm", "number_of_lesions",
  "skin_photosensitivity.High", "skin_photosensitivity.Low",
  "sunburns_last_year"
)
x_train <- as.matrix(train_final[, bic_predictors])
y_train <- ifelse(train_final$Cancer == "Malignant", 1, 0)
x_test <- as.matrix(test_final[, bic_predictors])



dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train)
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test)

set.seed(123)
xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  nrounds = 100,
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.1,
  verbose = 0
)

xgb_probs <- predict(xgb_model, dtest)

ensemble_probs <- (xgb_probs + bic_probs) / 2
final_preds <- ifelse(ensemble_probs > 0.5, "Malignant", "Benign")

submission_bic_boost <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(test_final),
  Cancer = final_preds
)

write_csv(submission_bic_boost, "submission_bic_boost.csv")
```

## Logit + Fixing the Skew on Numerical Variables

```{r}
true_numeric_vars <- c("age", "avg_daily_uv", "lesion_size_mm", "number_of_lesions", "sunburns_last_year")
skew_vals <- sapply(train_final[, true_numeric_vars], skewness)
print(skew_vals)

for (var in true_numeric_vars) {
  print(
    ggplot(train_final, aes_string(x = var)) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "skyblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_density(color = "darkblue", size = 1) +
      ggtitle(paste("Histogram & Density of", var)) +
      theme_minimal()
  )
}

train_final_skew <- train_final
train_final_skew$number_of_lesions <- log1p(train_final_skew$number_of_lesions)
train_final_skew$sunburns_last_year <- log1p(train_final_skew$sunburns_last_year)
test_final_skew <- test_final
test_final_skew$number_of_lesions <- log1p(test_final_skew$number_of_lesions)
test_final_skew$sunburns_last_year <- log1p(test_final_skew$sunburns_last_year)
sapply(train_final_skew[c("number_of_lesions", "sunburns_last_year")], skewness)

set.seed(123)

cv_model <- train(
  bic_formula,
  data = train_final_skew,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = cv_ctrl,
)

# Step 5: Review cross-validated AUC

bic_skew_preds <- predict(cv_model, newdata = test_final_skew)

submission_bic_skew <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(test_final),  # or original test IDs if available

)
```
